entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I... I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for these for months.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF77209. It's about the new cycling shoes I bought.
Okay, thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes, delivered 16 days ago. What seems to be the issue with them?

They just... they're awful. I've tried adjusting the cleats three different times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride for ten minutes. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. I really need that money back for other expenses.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I just hope you can help.

Alright, Sarah, I've checked the policy. It looks like you are well within the 90-day return window for these shoes. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great day.
